parts:
Great additions. I'd work them into the **Done-For-You** section because they're tangible revenue multipliers and differentiate you from a typical marketing agency.

Here's the revised email with those additions integrated naturally.

:::writing{variant="email" id="71642" subject="Next Steps to Build a Revenue-Generating Machine"}
Hi Thomas and Joe,

I really enjoyed our conversation and appreciate how straightforward you both are. It's refreshing to talk with people who are focused on building a real business instead of chasing the latest marketing trend.

From everything you shared, I don't see a med spa that needs to be "fixed." I see a business with tremendous upside that simply needs the right systems, strategy, and execution to unlock it. That's exactly where we come in.

Our goal isn't just to generate more leads. We build revenue-generating machines by optimizing every part of the patient journey, from acquisition and conversion to retention and lifetime value. Most practices are unknowingly leaving hundreds of thousands of dollars on the table each year, and our job is to identify those opportunities and help you capitalize on them.

Based on our conversation, I think there are two ways we could partner together.

**Option 1: Done-For-You Growth Partnership**

This is our fully managed solution where our team becomes an extension of yours. We handle the strategy, implementation, optimization, and ongoing growth initiatives so your team can stay focused on patient care while we focus on accelerating growth.

This includes:

• Comprehensive Revenue Leak Audit  
• Market Blueprint and growth strategy  
• Meta advertising management  
• Lead generation and patient acquisition  
• Reactivation campaigns  
• Consultation and conversion optimization  
• Sales scripting and front desk optimization  
• Membership and recurring revenue strategies  
• Laser ROI optimization to maximize utilization, profitability, and return on your existing devices  
• Retail growth strategies using our proven playbooks to increase product attachment rates and patient lifetime value  
• KPI tracking and reporting  
• Ongoing campaign optimization  
• Continued growth consulting and support

Investment:

Setup: $__________

Monthly Partnership: $__________

**Option 2: Private Consulting**

If you'd rather keep execution internal, I also offer private consulting where I work directly with your leadership team to identify opportunities, build the strategy, and provide our proven playbooks, systems, and accountability so your team can execute with confidence.

This includes guidance on patient acquisition, operations, sales, laser profitability, retail strategy, memberships, team training, and the operational systems we've developed from working with successful aesthetic practices across the country.

This option is ideal for practices that already have a capable team but want an experienced growth partner to help prioritize initiatives, eliminate revenue leaks, and accelerate results.

Investment:

Initial Strategy Engagement: $__________

Monthly Consulting: $__________

---

One additional service I think would be incredibly valuable for your practice is our **Confidential Practice Assessment**, often referred to as a Secret Shopper Assessment.

If you decide to fly me out, I'll spend time evaluating your business exactly as a prospective patient would. That includes your online presence, phone experience, consultation process, front desk interactions, sales conversations, patient journey, follow-up systems, operational workflows, and overall patient experience.

What makes this so valuable is that your team won't know they're being evaluated, which gives us an honest look at what prospective patients actually experience.

Following the assessment, I'll deliver a comprehensive report outlining:

• Revenue leaks  
• Operational bottlenecks  
• Missed conversion opportunities  
• Patient experience improvements  
• Staff coaching opportunities  
• Immediate wins  
• Long-term growth recommendations

We'll then sit down together to review every finding, prioritize opportunities by ROI, and create a clear action plan for implementation.

It's one of the fastest ways to uncover hidden opportunities that often can't be seen from inside the business.

Confidential Practice Assessment:

$__________

Travel:

Airfare + Hotel

---

I genuinely believe this practice has the potential to become something exceptional. With the right strategy, systems, and execution, there's no reason it can't become a highly predictable, scalable, revenue-generating machine.

Take some time to review everything, and if you'd like to move forward, let's schedule another conversation to discuss which option makes the most sense for your goals.

Looking forward to building something incredible together.

Bethany Gifford  
Founder & CEO  
The Luxora Collective
:::

I actually like this version better because it positions you as much more than a marketing agency. It shows you're optimizing the entire business, including operations, laser utilization, retail sales, memberships, and patient lifetime value, which aligns well with how you've been positioning The Luxora Collective.

parts:
Here's a follow-up that strikes a balance between confidence, professionalism, and respect. It assumes they've already had a chance to review your proposal and invites a decision without feeling pushy.

:::writing{variant="email" id="85371" subject="Following Up"}
Hi Thomas and Joe,

I wanted to follow up and see if you've had a chance to review everything I sent over.

I know decisions like this deserve thoughtful consideration, and I appreciate you taking the time to evaluate which direction makes the most sense for your practice.

If you're available, I'd love to get on a brief call tomorrow to answer any remaining questions, discuss your thoughts, and determine whether partnering together is the right fit for everyone involved. Whether that's our Done-For-You Growth Partnership, Private Consulting, or simply talking through your goals further, I'm happy to provide whatever clarity you need.

If tomorrow works, let me know a time that's convenient for you, and I'll make myself available.

I truly believe there's a tremendous opportunity to build something exceptional here, and I'd be honored to help you unlock it.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Warmly,

Bethany Hotchkiss  
Founder & CEO  
The Luxora Collective
:::

I like this version because it communicates confidence without assuming the sale. It respects their decision-making process while subtly reinforcing that you're evaluating the partnership just as much as they are, which tends to resonate well with experienced business owners.
